当您的应用需要向用户实时展示持续进行中的服务状态（如打车行程、外卖配送、航班动态等），且希望用户无需打开应用即可在锁屏、通知中心、状态栏等位置随时查看进展时，可使用 Live View Kit
当您需要构建具有明确开始和结束时间、内容需要动态更新的实时通知时，实况窗是最佳选择
活动总时长不得超过 8 小时，且展示内容不可用于营销、广告场景
添加锁屏实时卡片展示订单进度 / Add a lock-screen live card to show order progress
实现通知中心常驻显示当前行程状态 / Show current trip status persistently in Notification Center
接入实况窗显示外卖配送员位置和预计送达时间 / Integrate Live View to show courier location and ETA
用本地更新实时刷新比赛比分或活动倒计时 / Refresh match scores or event countdowns with local live updates
通过 Push Kit 推送更新实况窗中的最新状态 / Update Live View content via Push Kit pushes
在应用退到后台后继续展示任务进展 / Keep showing task progress after the app goes to background
管理实况窗的创建更新结束全生命周期 / Manage the full lifecycle of Live View creation updates and dismissal
控制实况窗高频刷新避免更新被限流 / Throttle frequent Live View refreshes to avoid rate limiting
为打车配送航班场景展示持续变化的关键信息 / Display continuously changing key info for ride-hailing delivery or flight scenarios
同步后端状态变化到锁屏实况展示 / Sync backend status changes to lock-screen live display
在实况窗中展示倒计时进度条和状态文案 / Show countdowns progress bars and status text in Live View
集成跨端框架应用的实况窗能力 / Integrate Live View capability into a cross-platform app
do_not_use_when: 需求是进行二维码/条形码扫描、识别或生成，并处理暗光、模糊、曲面码等复杂识读场景，应改用 scan-kit / The task is QR/barcode scanning, recognition, or generation, including difficult cases like low light, blur, or curved codes; use scan-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已开通实况窗服务权益，且目标设备为 HarmonyOS 5 及以上的 Phone 或 Tablet / The app has Live View service entitlement enabled, and the target device is a HarmonyOS 5+ Phone or Tablet
若采用远程更新方式，应用已开通 Push Kit 服务权益并完成相关配置 / If remote update is used, the app has Push Kit entitlement enabled and the related configuration completed
项目已按接入要求完成实况窗基础配置，并具备对应模板与生命周期管理能力 / The project has completed the required Live View integration setup and includes the needed templates and lifecycle handling
若依赖服务端实时更新，设备网络可用且推送链路正常 / If server-driven real-time updates are required, network connectivity and the push delivery path are available
inputs: 实况窗业务类型与场景信息 / Live View business type and scenario information
进行中服务的实时状态数据 / Real-time status data of the ongoing service
实况窗展示模板与界面内容 / Live View presentation template and UI content
实况窗实例标识与生命周期事件 / Live View instance identifier and lifecycle events
远程更新所需的推送消息数据（如适用） / Push message payload for remote updates if applicable

postconditions.statement: 已实现实况窗的创建、更新或结束流程之一，并围绕进行中服务状态进行展示 / A create, update, or end flow for Live View has been implemented, centered on the ongoing service state
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/configuration that explicitly creates, updates, or terminates a Live View for an ongoing service scenario?

postconditions.statement: 展示内容面向锁屏、通知中心或状态栏等实况窗触点，而非普通通知文案 / The displayed content targets Live View surfaces such as lock screen, notification center, or status bar, rather than ordinary notification text
postconditions.judge_prompt: From the edit set, is the implementation clearly aimed at Live View surfaces (lock screen/notification center/status bar) instead of only regular notifications?

postconditions.statement: 若采用远程更新，代码或配置已接入 Push Kit 与实况窗更新链路 / If remote updates are used, the code or configuration has wired Push Kit into the Live View update path
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the solution uses remote updates, do the edits show Push Kit being connected to Live View update handling?
